corpus.selection: sha absent from every existing receipt and corpus file; one source and one test file; oracle executes

declared_before_the_run.C1: at least one fresh real commit is VERIFIED by a generated literal that was absent from the parent source
declared_before_the_run.C2: no verified candidate breaks a test that passed on the parent
declared_before_the_run.C3: the generator never reads the commit diff or the human edit before the verdict
declared_before_the_run.C4: zero parameters stored, zero model calls, zero network calls
declared_before_the_run.C5: every counted row has a real failing test and a whole-file execution

what_this_is_not: not a benchmark: 15 real commits in one repository, producer-run, no independent verifier
not general SWE: a narrow generator over constants on executed lines
not trained: the candidates are calculated from failing inputs and existing literals
